question: What are all the versions in the httpcore-guide changelog?
answer:
### Version 1.0.9 (April 24th, 2025)
- Resolve https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vqfr-h8mv-ghfj with h11 dependency update. (#1008) [11]

### Version 1.0.8 (April 11th, 2025)
- Fix ’AttributeError’ when importing on Python 3.14. (#1005) [12]

### Version 1.0.7 (November 15th, 2024)
- Support ’proxy=?’ configuration on ’ConnectionPool()’. (#974) [8]

### Version 1.0.6 (October 1st, 2024)
- Relax ’trio’ dependency pinning. (#956) [9]
- Handle ’trio’ raising ’NotImplementedError’ on unsupported platforms. (#955) [9]
- Handle mapping ’ssl.SSLError’ to ’httpcore.ConnectError’. (#918) [9]

### 1.0.5 (March 27th, 2024)
- Handle ’EndOfStream’ exception for anyio backend. (#899) [13]
- Allow trio ’0.25.*’ series in package dependancies. (#903) [13]

### 1.0.4 (February 21st, 2024)
- Add ’target’ request extension. (#888) [14]
- Fix support for connection ’Upgrade’ and ’CONNECT’ when some data in the stream has been read. (#882) [14]

### 1.0.3 (February 13th, 2024)
- Fix support for async cancellations. (#880) [15]
- Fix trace extension when used with socks proxy. (#849) [15]
- Fix SSL context for connections using the "wss" scheme (#869) [15]

### 1.0.2 (November 10th, 2023)
- Fix ’float("inf")’ timeouts in ’Event.wait’ function. (#846) [16]

### 1.0.1 (November 3rd, 2023)
- Fix pool timeout to account for the total time spent retrying. [17]
- Raise a neater RuntimeError when the correct async deps are not installed. [17]
- Add support for synchronous TLS-in-TLS streams. [17]

### 1.0.0 (October 6th, 2023)
- Async support becomes fully optional. [7]
- Add support for Python 3.12. [7]

### 0.18.0 (September 8th, 2023)
- Add support for HTTPS proxies. [18]
- Drop Python 3.7 support. [18]
- Handle 'sni_hostname' extension with SOCKS proxy. [18]
- Handle HTTP/1.1 half-closed connections gracefully. [18]
- Change the type of 'Extensions' from 'Mapping[Str, Any]' to 'MutableMapping[Str, … [18]

### 0.17.3 (July 5th, 2023)
- Support async cancellations, ensuring that the connection pool is left in a clean state when [19]

### 0.17.2 (May 23th, 2023)
- Add 'socket_options' argument to 'ConnectionPool' and 'HTTProxy' classes. [20]
- Improve logging with per-module logger names. [20]
- Add 'sni_hostname' request extension. [20]
- Resolve race condition during import of 'anyio' package. [20]
- Enable TCP_NODELAY for all synchronous sockets. [20]

### 0.17.1 (May 17th, 2023)
- If 'retries' is set, then allow retries if an SSL handshake error occurs. [21]
- Improve correctness of tracebacks on network exceptions, by raising properly chained exceptions. [21]
- Prevent connection-hanging behaviour when HTTP/2 connections are closed by a server-sent 'GoAway' frame. [21]

### 0.17.0 (March 16th, 2023)
- Add DEBUG level logging. [22]
- Respect HTTP/2 max concurrent streams when settings updates are sent by server. [22]
- Increase the allowable HTTP header size to 100kB. [22]
- Add 'retries' option to SOCKS proxy classes. [22]

### 0.16.3 (December 20th, 2022)
- Allow 'ws' and 'wss' schemes. Allows us to properly support websocket upgrade connections. [23]
- Forwarding HTTP proxies use a connection-per-remote-host. Required by some proxy implementations. [23]
- Don't raise 'RuntimeError' when closing a connection pool with active connections. [23]

### 0.16.2 (November 25th, 2022)
- Revert 'Fix async cancellation behaviour', which introduced race conditions. (#627) [24]
- Raise 'RuntimeError' if attempting to use UNIX domain sockets on Windows. (#619) [24]

### 0.16.1 (November 17th, 2022)
- Fix HTTP/1.1 interim informational responses, such as "100 Continue". (#605) [25]

### 0.16.0 (October 11th, 2022)
- Support HTTP/1.1 informational responses. (#581) [26]
- Fix async cancellation behaviour. (#580) [26]
- Support 'h11' 0.14. (#579) [26]

### 0.15.0 (May 17th, 2022)
- Drop Python 3.6 support (#535) [27]
- Ensure HTTP proxy CONNECT requests include 'timeout' configuration. (#506) [27]
- Switch to explicit 'typing.Optional' for type hints. (#513) [27]
- For 'trio' map OSError exceptions to 'ConnectError'. (#543) [27]

### 0.14.7 (February 4th, 2022)
- Requests which raise a PoolTimeout need to be removed from the pool queue. (#502) [28]
- Fix AttributeError that happened when Socks5Connection were terminated. (#501) [28]

### 0.14.6 (February 1st, 2022)
- Fix SOCKS support for 'http://' URLs. (#492) [29]
- Resolve race condition around exceptions during streaming a response. (#491) [29]

### 0.14.5 (January 18th, 2022)
- SOCKS proxy support. (#478) [30]
- Add proxy_auth argument to HTTPProxy. (#481) [30]
- Improve error message on 'RemoteProtocolError' exception when server disconnects without sending a response. (#479) [30]

### 0.14.4 (January 5th, 2022)
- Support HTTP/2 on HTTPS tunnelling proxies. (#468) [31]
- Fix proxy headers missing on HTTP forwarding. (#456) [31]
- Only instantiate SSL context if required. (#457) [31]

### 0.14.3 (November 17th, 2021)
- Fix race condition when removing closed connections from the pool. (#437) [32]

### 0.14.2 (November 16th, 2021)
- Failed connections no longer remain in the pool. (Pull #433) [33]

### 0.14.1 (November 12th, 2021)
- 'max_connections' becomes optional. (Pull #429) [34]
- 'certifi' is now included in the install dependencies. (Pull #428) [34]
- 'h2' is now strictly optional. (Pull #428) [34]

### 0.14.0 (November 11th, 2021)
- The 0.14 release is a complete reworking of 'httpcore', addressing some underlying issues in the connection pooling and substantially redesigning the API to be more user friendly.
- Some of the lower-level API design makes the components more easily testable in isolation, and the package now has 100% test coverage.
- There’s some other neat bits in there too, such as the "trace" extension, which gives a hook into inspecting the internal events that occur during the request/response cycle.
- Determine if the outgoing request should log as HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2, rather than having to assume it’s HTTP/2 if the --http2 flag was passed. (Which may not actually be true.)
- Log SSL version info / certificate info.
- 'curio' support is not currently available in 0.14.0. If you’re using 'httpcore' with 'curio' please get in touch, so we can assess if we ought to prioritize it as a feature or not.

### 0.13.7 (September 13th, 2021)
- Fix broken error messaging when URL scheme is missing, or a non HTTP(S) scheme is used. (Pull #403) [35]

### 0.13.6 (June 15th, 2021)
- Close sockets when read or write timeouts occur. (Pull #365) [36]

### 0.13.5 (June 14th, 2021)
- Resolved niggles with AnyIO EOF behaviours. (Pull #358, #362) [37]

### 0.13.4 (June 9th, 2021)
- Improved error messaging when URL scheme is missing, or a non HTTP(S) scheme is used. (Pull #354) [38]

### 0.13.3 (May 6th, 2021)
- Support HTTP/2 prior knowledge, using 'httpcore.SyncConnectionPool(http1=False)' [39]

### 0.13.2 (April 29th, 2021)
- Improve error message for specific case of 'RemoteProtocolError' where server disconnects without sending a response [40]

### 0.13.1 (April 28th, 2021)
- More resilient testing for closed connections [41]
- Don’t raise exceptions on ungraceful connection closes [41]

### 0.13.0 (April 21st, 2021)
- Updates the core API to match the HTTPX Transport API introduced in HTTPX 0.18 onwards [10]
- Example of making requests with the new interface [10]

### 0.12.3 (December 7th, 2020)
- Abort SSL connections on close rather than waiting for remote EOF when using 'asyncio' [42]
- Fix exception raised in case of connect timeouts when using the 'anyio' backend [42]
- Fix 'Host' header precedence for ':authority' in HTTP/2 [42]

### 0.12.2 (November 20th, 2020)
- Properly wrap connect errors on the asyncio backend [43]
- Fix 'ImportError' occurring on Python 3.9 when using the HTTP/1.1 sync client in a multithreaded context [43]

### 0.12.1 (November 7th, 2020)
- Add connect retries [44]

### 0.12.0 (October 6th, 2020)
- HTTP header casing is now preserved, rather than always sent in lowercase [45]

### 0.11.1 (September 28nd, 2020)
- Add await to async semaphore release() coroutine (#197) [46]
- Drop incorrect curio classifier (#192) [46]

### 0.11.0 (September 22nd, 2020)
- Moved and changed the request interface to allow extensions for future features such as trailing headers, HTTP/2 server push, and CONNECT/Upgrade connections. [47]

### 0.10.2 (August 20th, 2020)
- Added Unix Domain Socket support (Pull #139) [48]

### 0.10.1 (August 7th, 2020)
- Included 'max_keepalive_connections' on 'AsyncHTTPProxy'/ 'SyncHTTPProxy' classes. [49]

### 0.10.0 (August 7th, 2020)
- HTTP/2 support became optional. (Pull #121, #130) [50]

### Also in this list, without details
8 more item(s) in this list didn't fit in the context, so they are named here from the document's headings only: 0.9.1 (May 27th, 2020); 0.9.0 (May 21th, 2020); 0.8.4 (May 11th, 2020); 0.8.3 (May 6rd, 2020); 0.8.2 (May 3rd, 2020); 0.8.1 (April 30th, 2020); 0.8.0 (April 30th, 2020); 0.7.0 (March 5th, 2020).
